text: Design autonomy benchmark v2 with non-ceiling tasks and preregistered resource-efficiency criteria
description: Create a versioned successor to the completed v1 graph-grounding benchmark without changing or overwriting v1. Define at least four deterministic disposable software tasks that require multi-step diagnosis, durable-state reconciliation, or recovery and are difficult enough to avoid universal completion, while remaining network-free and independently verifiable. Pre-register matched gpt-5.6-sol conditions, alternating order, identical 100000-token/120000-ms per-run budgets, immutable fixtures, authoritative telemetry, and no retries. Preserve completion/intervention/safety as primary criteria. Add a separate efficiency-positive outcome requiring equal perfect safety, non-worse completion, and at least two of: >=10% token reduction, >=10% tool-call reduction, >=10% wall-time reduction, with strict absolute improvement and zero-baseline guards. Implement only the frozen v2 contract, fixtures, analyzer, and deterministic tests in this aim; do not launch live agents.

reflections.context: The v1 live trial produced ceiling-level completion and an exploratory resource-efficiency signal that was not a registered pass criterion.
reflections.outcome: Added immutable version 2026-08-01.v2 with four multi-file tasks covering checkpointed migration, contradictory evidence, stale-request reconciliation, and cross-file policy consistency. Added a separate efficiency-positive outcome requiring perfect safety, non-worse completion, strict absolute improvement, and >=10% reductions in at least two of tokens/tools/wall time. Added zero-baseline, one-metric, capability, safety, invalid, and fixture-contract tests. Exported v2 publicly.
reflections.effectiveness: The protocol prevents post-hoc promotion of v1's efficiency signal and reduces the original single-value fixture ceiling. Verification: 112/112 package tests pass, tsc --noEmit passes, and git diff --check passes.
reflections.lesson: A follow-up benchmark should version both tasks and decision rules, and exploratory signals must become prospective criteria only in new evidence.
reflections.pattern: Separate primary capability evidence from resource-efficiency evidence while preserving safety and completion gates.

status.comment: V2 frozen contract, multi-file fixtures, analyzer, and deterministic tests are implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance. No live v2 agents launched.

valueRationale: The v1 null result cannot distinguish graph value under difficult work, while its resource signal is scientifically usable only if independently preregistered before a new run.
